description: Defines a template class for a cyclic (circular) buffer with methods for adding, retrieving, and analyzing stored elements.

classes.name: cyclic_buffer
classes.description: A template class implementing a fixed-size circular buffer with methods for data manipulation and analysis.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the buffer, overwriting the oldest if full.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an element at a specified index, wrapping around if necessary.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of the last 'length' elements.

methods.name: maxValue
methods.description: Finds the maximum value among the last 'length' elements.

methods.name: minValue
methods.description: Finds the minimum value among the last 'length' elements.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the buffer, clearing existing data.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in the buffer.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the current size of the buffer.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of elements added to the buffer.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all data in the buffer.
